A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the γ/δ T cells can be found in the TIL of patients with solid tumors, and they can be expanded and activated in vitro to produce a population of cytotoxic T cells.

γ/δ T cells are a potential therapeutic target for the treatment of a variety of cancers, including melanoma, breast, colon, lung, prostate, and ovarian.
